entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments: ¶The Lord is King; let the peoples be in fear: his seat is on the winged ones; let the earth be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 99:2
segments: The Lord is great in Zion; he is high over all the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments: Let them give praise to your name, for it is great and to be feared; holy is he.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: The king's power is used for righteousness; you give true decisions, judging rightly in the land of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping at his feet; holy is he.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: ¶Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who gave honour to his name; they made prayers to the Lord, and he gave answers to them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: His voice came to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his witness, and the law which he gave them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: You gave them an answer, O Lord our God; you took away their sin, though you gave them punishment for their wrongdoing.

entries.title: Psalms 99:9
segments: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping with your faces turned to his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
